 Subject: EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
 Issued: Aprit 2007
Revised: June 2021, Oct. 2025
 PURPOSE: To define the Home's policy regarding equal employment and non-discriminatory
practices. PROCEDURE:
 1. St. Mary’s Home is fully committed to assuring fair and equal opportunity and equal
consideration to all applicants and employees in personnel matters including recruitment,
hiring, training, promotion, salaries and other compensation, transfer, and layoff or
termination with respect to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, gender
identity, gender expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual
orientation, age, marital status or disability. 2. Itis also the policy of St. Mary’s to hire only U.S. citizens and resident aliens who are
legally authorized to work in the United States. STATEMENT:
St. Mary's Home is proud to be an Equa! Opportunity Employer.
